observations: Flags are dominated by stipulated design knobs (21/40: budgets, grid/replicate/cohort counts, SBC×100, sigma, nats, quantile cutoffs) and internal probe results (13/40: cos stats, condition numbers, efficiency %, throughput, feasibility margins). Only 6 are external and 3 draw on real external data (the Zhang2017/NCT02415621 trial named in the title). Traceability skews to false positives: ~27 numbers are self-derived inline from stated inputs (4×4×20=320; 8×17+2=138) or anchored to named probes/scripts/the title trial. Only 10 are truly-orphaned, and most are stipulated author-frozen knobs that legitimately need no citation — the two real signals are the uncited 15-20% PSA-variation biology facts. Notable lint bug: cite: tokens present in paragraphs but para_has_citation=false. Redesign: exempt stipulated/inline-derived numbers, recognize cite: and title-declared task/trial, flag bare domain-fact numbers only.
